## Description

Extends the per-tenant flags (MDV-P0-028) with stages and a percentage, owner and description, and a one-click 'turn off for all' that hides a feature without deleting data. A clinical feature (recording, AI notes, e-prescriptions) cannot reach 'everyone' until clinical sign-off is recorded. Plans decide who is entitled; flags decide what is on.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a clinical flag, when is moved to everyone without sign-off, then the change is refused.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the kill switch, when is used, then the feature disappears for all tenants and no data is deleted.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a flag change, when is made, then it is audited with a reason.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
